features.title: Built around the platform you ship to
features.description: Use the Native design language with the APIs and constraints of WeChat.

0.title: A familiar component language
0.description: Compound parts, typed props and per-component imports. Follow the Native collection without pulling in the Web library.

1.title: Six themes, three families
1.description: Panel, Moon and Grass, each in light and dark. Register your own colors, fonts and radii in one place.

2.title: Made for the mini program
2.description: Taro hosts, WXSS-safe classes, WeChat Canvas and native platform adapters. No React Native runtime required.

3.title: Examples you can actually run
3.description: An independent WeChat example with official variants, four Blocks and seven customization guides.

4.title: Source you can make your own
4.description: Readable TypeScript, explicit exports and retained upstream attribution. Your business app stays separate.

5.title: Coverage you can inspect
5.description: Aligned to Native 0.114.0 with a 0.112.0 source baseline. Deferred APIs and device checks stay visible.
